eps.o: Spear's lifeless body is reanimated to enact brutal vengeance.
A zombified Spear wanders aimlessly with no purpose until a distant sound awakens something deep inside and calls to him like a beacon from the past.
Spear is drawn to follow a very familiar creature, which leads him to make a horrific discovery.
A pack of Entelodont-like creatures attack Mira's village, forcing the villagers to flee. Can Fang and her children investigate the issue?
The ramifications of Spear's return from the dead reverberate through the world he once knew.
A rescue party makes a terrifying discovery while attempting to save villagers from a pack of hideous hyena-like creatures.
Spear's world shatters when he's shunned by everyone and finally realizes what he has become.
Spear finds a new path after meeting a primordial tribe that time forgot while Mira searches for Spear.
Spear starts to question his new life with the Black River people. Can he investigate the issue?
Spear is caught in an epic battle to appease the bloodlust of the Black River People.
